reviews.comment: I took Professor Parish's COMM 203 online over the summer. Even though it was an online class, Dr. Parish did an amazing job of answering all the messages I sent, giving great feedback on each of my speeches, and providing all the resources to help improve the aspects of my speeches that needed work. It's clear that she cares about her students.

Professor Parish is a good teacher and really sweet. Her exams are kind of difficult so make sure you study and take good notes. The lectures felt kind of pointless, like you just needed the information to spit up on the exam, did not really feel like I was actually learning anything.

Dr. Parish is an amazing professor. I learned a lot in her class and all the assignments really help prepare you for the exams. You NEED to study for her exams to do well in the class. Attandance is not mandatory but she doesn't post her slides so you should go. I'd really recommend her if you actually want to learn!

Dr.Parish is amazing. The organization of the class and instructions can be unclear at times but a quick trip to office hours or an easy email should help. Dr. Parish cares for her students and always wants what is best for them. If you put great effort into your learning, you will succeed in any of the courses taught by her.

Easy class, sweet professor. It's clear that she LOVES what she does, and as long as you somewhat listen and turn in the assignments on time, you'll be just fine. Couple group assignments, couple PowerPoints, and just try your best on the exams.

Im gonna be completely honest, I learned alot in this class and it definitely made me prepared for the future. She is nice and cares alot, but she is also getting to a point where she just expects everyone to automatically know what she wants and is looking for. She rarely fully explains any projects in class and she is an extremely hard grader.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Parish had great feedback. Her assignments were straight forward and you have to make an effort to get a good grade. Her tests are difficult, but she offers extra credit and other resources so you will succeed. Just don't wait until the last min to study. She's great!

This course was really easy. Prof Parish is really sweet. The grading is a little confusing sometimes but if you follow the rubric, you'll do great. Make sure to go to class before big things are due so you know how to do the assignments otherwise this class was great!

The exams in 321 are so hard compared to the in-class material. She also likes to talk a lot, but not always about related material, and her slides and lecture notes are never posted. Lastly, every exam is cumulative which can be not the most fun. Overall, this class was extremely frustrating and put a lot of stress on an already hard semester.

I wouldn't take her again. Her exams were insanely difficult for no reason. They count so much for your grade, so if you do bad then your grade is bad. You have to go to lectures or you won't be able to answer half the questions. She also didn't post lecture slides. All the other assignments aren't bad, but the exams were set up for you to fail.

While Dr. Parish is a little awkward and her lectures are often common sense, I really like how the class is structured. She tells you exactly what to know for all assignments and tests, and if you study and make sure to manage your time well, you will do well and learn. Also, the TAs are a great resource.

I have a feeling she is actively fighting against the “communication courses are easy stereotype” and choosing to make this class overly difficult. Her lectures are mostly a ramble and she constantly seems to give her self compliments on her random things related to her own past professional life. TAs are also extremely slow to grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I am taking her currently for credit towards my certificate, and it has made my semester a lot more stressful. I study the study guide, book chapters, and lecture notes, and the exams are still impossible. I am having to put this class on top of my other classes, because the work load is insane, and the exams feel impossible to receive a good grade

She claims to be a pro strat comm person, however, as a professor she sucks. Her lectures make no sense because she can't stay on topic; no slides are ever posted. Online lectures are just YouTube videos. Does not explain her assignments. She takes ages to grade, but deadlines are set in stone. Her TAs tell you wrong stuff all the time.
She was a thorough grader and good communicator. Not a gimme class in the summer but did end up with an A.

Dr. Parish is one of the sweetest and caring professors I've ever had, but this course is more difficult than a lot of people would think. You have to go to most lectures, take good notes, and have access to textbook to make a good grade on tests. The grade I received was totally my fault. I would take Dr. Parish again. Wish I put more effort in.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sweetest professor, Tests are very difficult if you dont study. Her lectures are entertaining and attendance is not mandatory, however she gives extra credit sometimes for being there. She is brillinat in the strat comm field so her grading can be hard if you don't try, but her feedback helps so much!

Sweetest professor, I've taken her for COMM 323, COMM 322, and taking her COMM 321 in the fall. Her lectures are entertaining and attendance is not mandatory, however she gives extra credit sometimes for being there. She is brillinat in the strat comm field so her grading can be hard if you don't try, but her feedback helps so much! 10/10

I had professor Parish for Comm 322 and she's a good prof! The beginning of the class is a bit confusing about what is going on and what assignments are due when but after a few weeks you figure it out. She really cares about the material and her students so lectures are engaging and she's always happy to help out if you have questions.
She is nice but literally doesn't believe in A's. She is a hard grader for no reason and refuses to round up. Most profs believe in rounding but she obviously does not. Don't take her.

I don't recommend you take Dr. Parish, unless you do well with exams. Exams can be really hard because she doesn't post her slides, so go to class. There are 3 projects and they are easy, one of them is a group project. She's nice and recommends coming for office hours if you need any help.

Professor Parish is amazing! She truly cares about the material and her students. The class grades come from a few tests and papers, but if you put in effort on them you'll do fine. Her lectures are engaging and she encourages class participation and has in-class activities some days that were always fun.

Dr. Parish is a great professor! The class is enjoyable and easy if you attend class at least semi-regularly (mainly test review days!) There aren't many assignments at all, so give yourself plenty of time to prepare and do them well. Overall a great class!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The "event planning" project was a complete disaster. In a classroom with all girls, you can imagine the drama - Well let's just say that she didn't stop it. When she was asking for opinions in the class someone raised their hand and was yelled at in front of the entire class. Easy course but I would never take a class with her again. traumatic.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Parish is the best professor I had at Texas A&M. I would not be where I am today in life without her. Take her and get to know her she truly cares and is such a wonderful person. You will not regret taking her class!!

Dr. Parish is a fantastic professor, I wish I got the grade I desired but at this point, I am more grateful that I had Dr. Parish than getting the grade because she really was an inspiration to me. I came into the class as a timid speaker and in the 3-week summer course I had with her, I felt that I had become a more confident and outgoing speaker.

LOVE Dr.Parish. I love her personality and she's also a great professor. There's 2 case briefs and 3 exams. Really easy workload. You can only get the notes if you come to class. Exams aren't too bad. Gives a few opportunities for extra credit. Amazing lectures that were entertaining... even at 8am :)
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Parish is a really sweet prof, but she is a lot to handle at 8am. Pretty easy A, but wouldn't take her again. Go to class and the exam reviews and you'll be fine. Only things I read from the book were a couple case studies (that she specifically pointed out) and I was good. She offered 4 points of extra credit, take it.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: LOVE LOVE LOVE Dr. Parish!! Took her for Public Relations because that is what I want to do and she is hands down the best person to learn it from. The only thing I will say is the class is very test and lecture heavy. Like the tests are your grade pretty much and if you don't come to class you don't get the lecture or notes so recommend going,

Lectures repeat the textbook. If you read each chapter and take good notes, the lecture is unnecessary. The only day class is important is the day before the exam -- test review is SUPER helpful. Very sweet prof that wants to get to know her students personally. Class is very participative but doesn't add anything to the content.

okay professor but didn't love her. pop quizzes randomly throughout the year and a writing assignment (2000+ words) but she lets you revise it. in class she just talks about her personal life and we have some discussions about class material but no tests. group project at end of year. this is the first comm course i won't have gotten an A in.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: One of the best profs Ive ever had! If you get the chance to take Dr. Parish, DO IT! HNR-COMM 323 was based on 3 papers and one partner project. She is so sweet and an easy grader. Discussion based, but the class is super interesting if youre interested in PR.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Parish is hands down the best professor I have ever taken, and I have had her for a few classes during my time at A&M. If you want a professor who cares, wants you to succeed, and makes classes manageable and organized - this is your ticket. She really knows what she is talking about. Take her classes for fun and to prepare for your career!

Event planning is very self-explanatory, so I didn't learn too much. We had two exams and five exercises, and they felt silly and time-consuming, but they were easy. We also had a final partner project where we had to plan an actual event. It was a lot of work and felt pointless during COVID, but at least she's an easy grader. She is very sweet!

Professor Parish is very kind and easy going. This 400 level class was not hard at all! There are assignments every week, but even papers are only 1-2 pages. No tests, just quizzes, that you can use the textbook for. Parish is very willing to work with students and wants them to succeed.

I took intro to social media with Dr. Parish and loved it! She really cares about students and tries to help in any way possible. One of the sweetest profs I've had, will definitely be taking her advanced social media course!
Sweetest lady. Attendance is mandatory because there is a sign in sheet. Easy projects and tests. She is very enthusiastic and cares. Highly recommend her.

Such a great class with Dr Parish! No tests, a majority of your grade is based on a group project, which is not too difficult if you work together, and other presentations throughout the semester. It's a very hands on class which is fun, very minimal work outside of class!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Parish's COMM 323 class and had a wonderful experience. If you don't read the textbook, it will make passing the class a lot harder for you. She's great when it comes to office hours and answering students' questions about assignments. Attendance is not mandatory, but there were perks to showing up to class (extra-credit assignments).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Her tests are very tough, but get easier as you go. She did offer extra credit at the end of the semester to those who show up to class, but attendance is not mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Nancy is such a great professor. She is super caring and really wants her students to succeed. She grades the class based off 3 tests, 25% each and a group presentation worth 25%. After our first test grades came back she realized we needed a little help and provided extra credit for those who came to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Nancy is awesome. She's so kind and honestly a great person all around. On top of all of that, she's an excellent teacher and lecturer. Her tests are pretty difficult but they get easier as the semester goes on. On top of that, GO TO CLASS!! She gives heckin extra credit that will make it very easy get an A. Not an easy class, but an amazing prof

Dr. Parish is a great professor. She is a pretty good lecturer, and has years of actual experience in the subjects she teaches. She is willing to listen and take feedback when expressing concern over a test or grades, which makes handling the discussion of academic matters much less stressful. She cares about your success if you show initiative.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Parish is extremely knowledgeable about communications/PR and she is a great resource. However, I was super excited about her class but honestly I hate it. Lectures are interesting because we learn about real life examples, but often her exams are completely different. Just a little frustrating when your grade relies on just exams and a project
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I love Dr Parish she helped me so much in this class. I took her in summer 18 and I'm glad I did. Her class is awesome and interesting. If I could take her again I will. She is very helpful and loves what she does. She made me a better speaker and helped me gain confidence.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Parish is all around a great person to be around. Her lectures are interesting and she knows how to help you become a great speaker!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I took this class in the summer, it was very fast paced. But, Nancy Parish is one of the most down to earth professors I have ever had. She is passionate about Media Campaigns, as well as, making sure that you understand the usage of said media campaigns. Her lectures always include fun and memorable ads that are really beneficial to your learning.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Parish for my first semester at TAMU and it was also her first semester here coming from Florida. I was terrified of public speaking and she helped me out SO much! I used her office hours multiple times and she was super helpful with my speeches. Grades on the nicer side and ALWAYS use her speech outlines. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!
